notes: Riverwalk on the river by day, the stage-mistress's dugout at its tie by the stage shelter (the upriver Hist village's canoes are ground clutter in the studio, not floating hulls). Lead-in (unfilmed): E boards, E casts off, W paddles out. Filmed: the jump press goes over the side (2.12's jump clips, a leap over the gunwale, no cut), W swims a few metres, E climbs back in at the side (the low mantle), W paddles on. Taking the canoe unpaid may file a theft; the scene expects only the boat and the swim.

steps.name: board
steps.transition: E at the canoe: the player climbs aboard

steps.name: cast-off
steps.transition: E aboard: the canoe casts off

steps.name: paddle-out
steps.transition: W held: seated at the paddle, the canoe under way on the river

steps.name: jump-overboard
steps.transition: Shift (the jump) aboard: the player leaps up over the gunwale and drops into the river beside the canoe, swimming; the canoe drifts on

steps.name: swim
steps.transition: W held: the player swims a few metres alongside the canoe

steps.name: climb-back-in
steps.transition: E at the side: the swimmer climbs back into the canoe (the low mantle) and sits at the paddle

steps.name: paddle-on
steps.transition: W held: back in the seat, the player paddles on
